ligature_policy: Preserve literal extracted expansions; NFC/NFKC variants separately reported. No combining or dehyphenation.
phi_policy: The actual phi1 outline is the open-loop varphi shape; the source ToUnicode phi U+03C6 is preserved, despite Adobe-name-table convention U+03D5.
unembedded_font: Only first-page arXiv identification uses standard Times-Roman with explicit WinAnsiEncoding; no embedded outline is falsely claimed. Its source characters are counted.
